eq-ch09-framework-stage: One stage increment: minus the flux divergence plus the sum of the registered forcing sources, times $\Delta t$.
eq-ch09-user-add: User stage forcings add their `hydro_du` to the native stage increment.
eq-ch09-coriolis-force: The Coriolis momentum increment $-2\Delta t\,\Omega \times m$, which does no work.
eq-ch09-coriolis-sph: A Cartesian rotation vector projected onto the local spherical-polar basis.
eq-ch09-viscosity-flux: Viscous momentum flux (Newtonian stress) and energy flux (viscous work plus Fourier conduction).
eq-ch09-viscosity-stencil: Diffusion face derivatives: normal difference, averaged tangential differences and the two-cell face mean.
eq-ch09-viscosity-dt: The explicit diffusion time-step limit $h_{\min}^2/(2 n_{\mathrm{dim}} K_{\Delta t})$.
eq-ch09-viscosity-adiabat: Conduction heats a resting adiabat at $\kappa |g_1|^2 c_{v,\mathrm d}/(R_{\mathrm d} c_{p,\mathrm d}^2 T)$.
eq-ch09-csdiffusion-flux: Cubed-sphere viscous momentum and energy fluxes through a face of unit normal $\hat{\mathbf n}$, from the traction $\boldsymbol\Pi\cdot\hat{\mathbf n}$.
eq-ch09-csdiffusion-grad: The Cartesian velocity gradient through the discrete map from panel indices to Cartesian position; exact for affine velocity.
eq-ch09-csdiffusion-radial: The radial heat flux of the cubed sphere, exact for the spherical conduction profile $T=A+B/r$.
eq-ch09-csdiffusion-penalty: The symmetric interior penalty on the jump of the face traces at a block edge, conservative on both sides.
eq-ch09-csdiffusion-sdirk: The radial conduction of one column as a linear system at frozen density, advanced by two-stage SDIRK.
eq-ch09-wallcoef-extrap: The diffusion coefficient at a wall face is linearly extrapolated from the two nearest cells.
eq-ch09-x1profile-mp: Mean-of-products versus product-of-means face coefficients, which differ by a quarter of the product of the two jumps.
eq-ch09-heating-body: Body heating adds $\Delta t\,\dot T\rho c_v$ to energy in cells within the pressure window.
eq-ch09-heating-flux: A boundary heat flux is spread uniformly over the $n_{\mathrm{dep}}$ cells next to the boundary.
eq-ch09-relax-temp: Bottom temperature relaxation of the bottom cell's energy towards `btemp` at time scale $\tau$.
eq-ch09-relax-face: With `at-face`, the relaxation target is the temperature extrapolated to the bottom face, with a matching gain.
eq-ch09-relax-velo: Bottom velocity relaxation of covariant momentum towards the target velocity.
eq-ch09-relax-comp: Bottom composition relaxation towards the target mass fractions at fixed total density.
eq-ch09-sponge-drag: Sponge-layer Rayleigh drag with a $\sin^2$ profile of the scaled distance.
eq-ch09-heating-overlap: The length of each cell that lies inside the forced layer, clamped to the layer and to zero.
eq-ch09-heating-layer: With `thickness`, a cell receives the flux in one stage times its share of the layer, spread over its own width.
